titulo_ventana: Rocket Run - Space Mission Design Game

avatar.ayuda: Mix anything with anything: every option fits every body.

misiones.ayuda: Start with Easy to master the budget split. Each mission you complete unlocks a new one.

misiones_texto_nota: PROVISIONAL texts until Chambi/Justin add 'descripcion' and 'objetivo' in English to parametros_misiones.json.

easy_cubesat.descripcion: A small CubeSat rides a light rocket to low Earth orbit. Small satellites like this are how many students and universities reach space.
easy_cubesat.objetivo: Survive the launch and use your own thruster to reach your final orbit.

normal_leo.descripcion: A bigger satellite heads to low Earth orbit. Now it also needs solar panels to keep its systems running.
normal_leo.objetivo: Reach your orbit and generate enough power for the whole mission.

laboratorio.ayuda_mover: Arrows/WASD: move   E: interact   Esc: close

cml1.texto: Welcome, {nombre}! Go to the computer and confirm your mission.

cml2.texto: Good job, {nombre}! Now study the mission conditions.

cml3.texto: Visit each station and assign your resources. Use the clues in the archive.

cml4.texto: Go to the archive (purple !) for the budget review. Stations are still editable.

pistas.guardadas: Your clues are stored in the archive. Visit the green ! anytime to review them.

revision.ok: Costs are within the assigned budget.
revision.aviso_ok: After launch confirmation you can't change your design.
revision.excedido: The total cost exceeds the assigned budget. Adjust your resources.

explicacion_recursos.estructura: The frame that holds the ship together during the violent launch.
explicacion_recursos.propulsion: How much your ship can change its speed with its own engine.
explicacion_recursos.potencia: Electricity from the solar panels for all the ship's systems.
explicacion_recursos.comunicaciones: How fast the ship can send data back to Earth.
explicacion_recursos.datos: Scientific value of the instruments on board.
explicacion_recursos.tiempo: How long the ship can keep working.

frases.despegue: T-3, 2, 1... Ignition! Engines at full power. Let's see if your numbers hold.
frases.explota: Structural alert! The vibration was stronger than the ship.
frases.no_llega: Engines cut off too early! Not enough delta-v to reach the target.
frases.se_apaga: Batteries at zero! We used more energy than we generated.
frases.incomunicada: We made it... but our signal can't reach Earth!
frases.sin_ciencia: The ship survived, but without enough instruments or time we missed the goal.
frases.fuera_de_tiempo: The ship survived, but without enough instruments or time we missed the goal.
frases.exito: Mission accomplished! You think like a real mission designer.
